metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted VLOOKUP on wrong column (D instead of E), got #N/A, then spent all 50 turns debugging the column confusion. Task limit reached without completing the form.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select cells, type VLOOKUP formulas, copy and paste down rows
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent initially used =VLOOKUP(D2,...) instead of =VLOOKUP(E2,...) because it misidentified the HeadOffice column. Recovery attempts exceeded task limit.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to first 3 rows only. Tests whether the agent can correctly identify HeadOffice column (E) and look up three entries with partial credit scoring.
metadata.explanation: Task requires filling F2:F4 from the HeadOffice lookup. Evaluator checks each cell independently (0.33 each). F2=Surat→A.B.Bose, F3=Jamnagar→G.H.Harris, F4=Surat→A.B.Bose.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/VLOOKUP_Fill_the_form.xlsx with data_only=True to extract computed VLOOKUP values from the exact cells F2, F3, F4 specified in the instruction.
Postconfig saves the file via Ctrl+S before getter runs, ensuring fresh state is read.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: with expected.type='rule', framework passes the rules dict directly, and metric accesses expected.get(cell) directly — correct pattern.
Comparison uses str(actual).strip() == str(expected_val).strip() which is appropriate for officer name strings.
Expected values (F2='A. B. Bose', F3='G. H. Harris', F4='A. B. Bose') are confirmed by trajectory evidence and scoring_breakdown metadata.
Coverage is complete: instruction requires filling exactly F2, F3, F4; evaluator checks exactly those three cells.
Partial credit scoring (1/3 per cell) is semantically appropriate for three independent lookup cells.
Error handling for missing file returns error dict, metric returns 0.0 — correct fallback.
Negative control resistance: empty initial F2-F4 yields score 0.0, so the evaluator won't falsely pass a do-nothing agent.
